extra.message: User input from 'username' query parameter is directly concatenated into a Jinja2 template string via from_string(). An attacker can inject Jinja2 template syntax (e.g., {{config}}, {{''.__class__.__mro__[1].__subclasses__()}}) to achieve arbitrary code execution.

cwe: CWE-1336: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine
